review.note: Date is right (act of March 4, 1921, 41 Stat. 1407), but the claim leaves out the President because the date is inauguration day. The act was approved by Wilson, who signed the closing bills of the 66th Congress at the Capitol that morning. Authority: act of Congress.

historySource.indexText: Established as Hot Springs Reservation April 20, 1832; dedicated to public use as a park June 16, 1880; redesignated March 4, 1921. Boundary changes: June 22, 1892; July 14, 1892; Feb. 21, 1903; May 23, 1906; Sept. 18, 1922; June 5, 1924; June 25, 1930; Feb. 14, 1931; June 15, 1936; June 24, 1938; Aug. 10, 1939; Aug. 24, 1954; Aug. 18, 1958; Sept. 21, 1959; Aug. 2, 1993.
